judge_input.description: The rest of the links that are found on this page happen to be absolute paths which do not have any specified hostname on them, but these particular ones here are the exception, because they instead make use of build_absolute_uri. The situation is that I happen to be running linkding sitting behind two different load balancers, and it is this setup which is what makes these particular links bubble up the "internal" hostname, rather than showing the actual hostname that I really used to get to the page in the first place.
